5. EXACT BOWTIE COUNTEREXAMPLE TO NATURAL GLUING
Take two physical triangles sharing vertex0:
  A=(01),(02),(12), B=(03),(04),(34).
Compare the grouped order A then B with the interleaved order

The exact computation can also be read as a short complete path certificate. Write each five-bit state in vertex order0,1,2,3,4. There are exactly four closed paths with unit weight through all six C gates:

  01001 ->10001 ->10001 ->00101 ->00101 ->01001 ->01001;
  10101 ->10101 ->00111 ->00111 ->10110 ->10110 ->10101.
C is allowed only when the acted pair is unequal, and either preserves or exchanges that unequal pair. The four displayed histories meet that rule; exhaustive exact propagation finds no others. Thus trace4.

FINAL EPR* DETERMINANT LIFT AND VARIANCE GATE
2026-10-08. Status: internally derived, exact finite checks; no independent external validation, priority clearance, generic sampler, FPRAS or hardness theorem.

Main retained advance
---------------------
Every finite closed critical EPR* gate network has an exact positive auxiliary expectation on a polynomial-size skew matrix. It retains all cycle parity and applies to arbitrary physical graphs, repeated gates and interleavings. Positivity is acquired globally, but polynomial relative variance/mixing is not. The determinant-estimator mechanism is closely related to established Godsil-Gutman/Barvinok ideas; the EPR* specialization and tuned gauge require separate priority review.

THEOREM D: exact global positive expectation
------------------------------------------
Let m four-port gates have nonnegative weights a_v,c_v,d_v, a_v>0, b_v=a_v+c_v+d_v, and uncomplemented matrix
 F_v=[[a,0,0,d],[0,b,c,0],[0,c,b,0],[d,0,0,a]].
Ports are (out_i,out_j,in_i,in_j). The physical closed circuit pairs output and subsequent input ports of every worldline with EQUALITY sewing. Idle qubits give a separate factor2 each.

Define a real skew matrix A_v by its upper entries
 A12=A34=sqrt(d_v/a_v),
 A13=A24=sqrt(b_v/a_v),
 A14=A23=sqrt(c_v/a_v).
Then Pf(A_v)=(d_v-b_v+c_v)/a_v=-1. For every subset S of the four ports,
 F_v(S)=a_v Pf((A_v)_S)^2,
with Pf(empty)=1 and odd principal Pfaffians0. Explicitly: empty/full coefficient a; 12/34 coefficient d; 13/24 coefficient b; 14/23 coefficient c. This is the local squared-Pfaffian identity.

Let E be the external wire matching on all4m ports (2m wire edges). Choose any fixed orientation of each external edge. For z in C^E let K(z) be blockdiag(A_1,...,A_m), plus z_e and -z_e in the two oriented positions of wire e. Overlapping internal and external entries are added.

For independent Rademacher xi_e and arbitrary fixed phases eta_e with |eta_e|=1,
 Z_circuit = (prod_v a_v) E_xi[ |Pf K(eta*xi)|^2 ]
           = (prod_v a_v) E_xi[ |det K(eta*xi)| ].              (D)
When every eta_e=1, K is real skew, detK=PfK^2>=0, so absolute values on det are unnecessary.

EPR* MATROID GLUING: EXACT CYCLE/CACTUS CONSTRUCTION AND SMALL OBSTRUCTIONS
Worker: epr_matroid_gluing. Run 2026-10-08. Bounded independent attack.
Status: internally derived exact identities and exact finite counterexamples; no external proof or priority validation. General EPR* FPRAS remains unresolved.

MAIN RESULT
For one critical EPR* gate per edge on an odd physical cycle of arbitrary length, the trace is exactly twice a weighted common-bases sum of two explicit matroids. This composes by direct sum on any odd-cycle cactus when all gates of each physical block occur consecutively. The final extension in section9 covers every cycle parity by a positive DAG-to-perfect-matching compiler, still with O(m) selectors. The binary odd-cycle construction has at most twice the number of gates as ground elements; the general-cactus path compiler has at most eight times the number of gates. All weights, independence oracles, initial sets, and coefficient range bounds are acquired explicitly. Chen-Liu 2610.06724v1 Corollary C.2 applies under its source-reported theorem. This is a restricted representation theorem, not a new hard-family approximation algorithm: the same cycle transfer calculation gives an exact polynomial-time algorithm on this family.

Two interleaved triangles provide an exact counterexample to scalar/direct-sum gluing. An independent closed triangle with trace zero can become part of a nonzero global trace when its boundary events interleave with another triangle. The unmodified transition matroid also cannot directly become the required common-bases representation: its transversal bases select Euler systems, whereas trace weights include dependent transversals with more loops.

1. EXACT CONVENTION AND ATTRIBUTION
The literal SWAP convention in the assignment is not the convention of the supplied triangle identity. Independent coefficient calculation first found that three literal SWAPs on three wires have trace 4 rather than the proposed coefficient 2. That failure is preserved in scripts/triangle_coefficients.py and results/triangle_coefficients.json and is ONLY a convention failure, not a failure of the correctly stated triangle identity.

After this independent check froze, worker epr_parity supplied the corrected local gate:

  C = 2 |psi+><psi+|, psi+=(|01>+|10>)/sqrt(2),
  D = (X tensor X) SWAP.
